MAVEN_PROFILE_NAME.description: Profile to use in mvn command to run the tests. Possible values are wls-srg (the default), integration-tests, toolkits-s

IT_TEST.description: Comma separated list of individual It test classes to be run e.g., ItParameterizedDomain, ItMiiUpdateDomainConfig, ItMii

OPERATOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The default log level is not set

KUBE_VERSION.description: Kubernetes version. Supported values depend on the Kind version. Kind 0.31.0: 1.35.0, 1.35, 1.34.3, 1.34, 1.33.7, 1.33,

PARALLEL_RUN.description: Runs tests in parallel. Default is true, test classes run in parallel.

NUMBER_OF_THREADS.description: Number of threads to run the classes in parallel, default is 3.

BASE_IMAGES_REPO.description: Repository to pull the base images. Make sure to modify the image names if you are modifying this parameter value.

WEBLOGIC_IMAGE_NAME.description: WebLogic base image name. Default is the image name in BASE_IMAGES_REPO. Use middleware/weblogic for OCR.

FMWINFRA_IMAGE_NAME.description: FWM Infra image name. Default is the image name in BASE_IMAGES_REPO. Use middleware/fmw-infrastructure for OCR.

DB_IMAGE_NAME.description: Oracle DB image name. Default is the image name in BASE_IMAGES_REPO, use database/enterprise for OCR.

COLLECT_LOGS_ON_SUCCESS.description: Collect logs for successful runs. Default is false.

steps.name: Run integration tests: junit summary
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import glob, os, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
files = [f for p in os.environ['J2GHA_JUNIT'].splitlines() for f in glob.glob(p, recursive=True)]
t = f = e = s = 0
for x in files:
    r = ET.parse(x).getroot()
    for ts in ([r] if r.tag == 'testsuite' else r.iter('testsuite')):
        t += int(ts.get('tests', 0)); f += int(ts.get('failures', 0)); e += int(ts.get('errors', 0)); s += int(ts.get('skipped', 0))
with open(os.environ.get('GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY', os.devnull), 'a') as out:
    out.write(f'### JUnit: {t} tests, {f} failures, {e} errors, {s} skipped ({len(files)} files)\n')
if not files and not True:
    raise SystemExit('no test report files found')
PY
